info.title: elevenlabs/eleven_multilingual_v2
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "elevenlabs/eleven_multilingual_v2", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

voice_id.description: ID of the voice to use, letters and digits only. Router places it in the ElevenLabs request path.

schema.description: Request body for ElevenLabs Text to Speech through Comfy Router. It is the v1 `POST /proxy/elevenlabs/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}` body plus a top-level `voice_id`: Router moves that value into the partner request path and removes it from the forwarded body. The `example` below omits `model_id`, which Router fills from the `{model}` path segment.

200.description: OK - the model's native `*/*` output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description: Raw audio bytes. The Content-Type and encoding follow the requested output_format and are forwarded from ElevenLabs. The example is a placeholder for the binary body, not JSON or base64.

pronunciation_dictionary_id.description: The ID of the pronunciation dictionary

version_id.description: The version ID of the pronunciation dictionary

ElevenLabsTTSRequest.description: Request body for ElevenLabs Text to Speech

apply_language_text_normalization.description: Controls language-specific text normalization. Can heavily increase latency. Currently only supported for Japanese.

apply_text_normalization.description:
Controls text normalization. 'auto' lets the system decide, 'on' always applies normalization,
'off' skips normalization.

language_code.description: Language code (ISO 639-1) to enforce for the model. If unsupported, an error is returned.

model_id.description: Identifier of the model to use. Query /v1/models to list available models.

next_request_ids.description: Request IDs of next generations for continuity. Maximum 3.

next_text.description: Text that comes after this request, used to improve speech continuity.

previous_request_ids.description: Request IDs of previous generations for continuity. Maximum 3.

previous_text.description: Text that came before this request, used to improve speech continuity.

pronunciation_dictionary_locators.description: List of pronunciation dictionary locators (id, version_id). Maximum 3 per request.

seed.description: Seed for deterministic generation. Must be between 0 and 4294967295.

text.description: The text that will be converted into speech.

use_pvc_as_ivc.description: Deprecated. If true, uses IVC version of voice instead of PVC.

similarity_boost.description: How closely the AI adheres to the original voice when replicating it.

speed.description: Speed adjustment. 1.0 is default, values below slow down, values above speed up.

stability.description: Stability of the voice. Lower values introduce broader emotional range.

style.description: Style exaggeration. Amplifies the style of the original speaker.

use_speaker_boost.description: Boosts similarity to the original speaker. Requires higher computational load.
